specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.11.0 rules remain active. This version changes how the suite is separated from PUAddress and DOAddress.

specification.description: v2.12.0 overlay: a trailing unit number also splits after street names without an English suffix (2245 CAMINO VIDA ROBLE 100), and a unit glued to its indicator gets a space (UNIT100 becomes UNIT 100).

changes: ADDRESS-SUITE-002: a standalone trailing number is the suite also when the street name has no English suffix, as in names in Spanish: 444 N EL CAMINO REAL 81, 3625 VISTA OCEANA 13 and 2245 CAMINO VIDA ROBLE 100 give Suite 81, 13 and 100 (decision 2026-11-19).

Conditions: the address starts with a house number, the street name has at least 2 words and its last word is not a highway word (HWY, HIGHWAY, ROUTE, RTE, SR, I, INTERSTATE, US, CR, COUNTY, FM, BOX), so HIGHWAY 101 or STATE ROUTE 78 stay whole.

A unit glued to its indicator is written with a space: UNIT100 becomes UNIT 100, SUITE100 SUITE 100, SPC131 SPC 131, STE5 STE 5. The indicator word and the number stay as received; # units (#21) and units already spaced do not change (decision 2026-11-19).
The suite keeps the indicator as it comes in the source (UNIT 100 in one file, 100 in another); TOBI is not affected by the difference (Majo, 2026-11-19).
Added acceptance tests AT-85 to AT-87.

glued_indicator_spacing.applies_to: Indicator words in secondary_indicators (APT, APARTMENT, STE, SUITE, UNIT, SP, SPC, SPACE) followed directly by the unit number.
glued_indicator_spacing.not_changed: Units after # (#21, # 159), units already spaced (UNIT 196, APT B) and standalone numbers (100).

standalone_trailing_unit.after_street_suffix: Kept from v1.4.0: 413 AUTUMN DR 220 gives Suite 220.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: PUAddress 2245 CAMINO VIDA ROBLE 100, 444 N EL CAMINO REAL 81, 3625 VISTA OCEANA 13
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Pickup Address without the number; Pickup Suite 100, 81 and 13

acceptance_tests_patch.case: DOAddress 2245 CAMINO VIDA ROBLE UNIT100, 100 SANTA FE DR SUITE100, 55 LAS FLORES DR SPC131
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Dropoff Suite UNIT 100, SUITE 100 and SPC 131; # units and spaced units unchanged
Address unchanged and Suite empty (highway word, or only one street word)

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-87 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0 to v2.12.0
